name: Texas Championship 2023
information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the second annual Texas Championship. While only residents of Texas are eligible win the title of Texas Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Texas Champion Titles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2023#33403-texas-champion-titles) tab.

Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead or behind schedule.

Please go through the other tabs on the website for more information, especially the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2023#32875-important-information) tab. If you have any other questions, feel free to check out the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2023#33404-faq) tab or contact us!

To learn more about Cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
